name: Crotonylfentanyl
summary: Crotonylfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and structural isomer of cyclopropylfentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug. In December 2019, the UNODC announced scheduling recommendations placing crotonylfentanyl into Schedule I.

uses.text: Crotonylfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and structural isomer of cyclopropylfentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like fentanyl, it is presumed to act mainly by activating the mu opioid receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 關於它的發表資料很少。和芬太尼一樣，一般推測它主要透過活化 μ 鴉片類受體發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 关于它的发表数据很少。和芬太尼一样，一般推测它主要通过活化 μ 鸦片类受体发挥作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in particular. Fentanyl analogues cause drowsiness, itching, nausea and dependence, and they can slow or stop breathing. Many have caused overdose deaths, and their strength in street products is unpredictable.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身的資料很少。芬太尼類似物會造成嗜睡、搔癢、噁心與依賴，並可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止。許多芬太尼類似物已造成過量死亡，而且在街頭產品中的強度難以預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身的数据很少。芬太尼类似物会造成嗜睡、搔痒、恶心与依赖，并可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止。许多芬太尼类似物已造成过量死亡，而且在街头产品中的强度难以预测。

fact.en: Crotonylfentanyl and cyclopropylfentanyl have exactly the same atoms. In one they form a short chain with a double bond, in the other a tight three-carbon ring.
fact.zh: 巴豆醯芬太尼與環丙基芬太尼的原子組成完全相同。前者的原子排成一條帶雙鍵的短鏈，後者則形成緊密的三碳環。
fact.zhHans: 巴豆酰芬太尼与环丙基芬太尼的原子组成完全相同。前者的原子排成一条带双键的短链，后者则形成紧密的三碳环。
